name: Creating a project and sending it to an 1-1 Chat
instruction: Open FYI, navigate to the project section click on the plus icon to create a project. Create a new project, click on the plus icon and click on media gallery add an image and name the project after naming the project i want you to add test 14 as an editor and navigate to the chat section search for test 11 and send him the project which you just created
success: The newly created project is successfully sent to Test 11 in the chat
